faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) position at IIT Kharagpur is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Sc., M.Com, MA, or MBA degree to be eligible for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, experience in Central Autonomous Institutions will be preferred for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) position is up to Rs. 40,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant (Multi Tasking) position at IIT Kharagpur is a temporary job.
